# Country scope (local human player). Pure O(1) scalar variable checks; 0 iterators, 0 gamestate mutations.

# 1. Red Alert: Imperial Entropy >= 60 (crisis/decay danger)
oe_alert_high_entropy = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        is_subject = no
        oe_ent_rule_active = yes
        has_variable = oe_ent_index
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index >= 60 }
    }
}

# 2. Green Alert: Praetorian Prefecture / Classical Diocese slot available (BYZ/ROM)
oe_alert_prf_available = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        is_ai = no
        is_rebel_country = no
        is_subject = no
        exists = international_organization:oe_byz_policy_org
        has_variable = oe_alert_cache_prf_avail
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alert_cache_prf_avail } var:oe_alert_cache_prf_avail >= 1 }
    }
}
